```{r}
#| label: setup
#| context: setup
#| include: false

library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dbplyr)
library(DT)
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)

# Resolve project files whether the app is served from the project root or from
# src/reference:

c("src/r/reference_gui_db.R", "../r/reference_gui_db.R") %>%
  keep(fs::file_exists) %>%
  first() %>%
  source()

con <- reference_connect()

onStop(
  function() {
    dbDisconnect(con)
  }
)

# Browser-side helpers (copy to clipboard, unsaved-edit guard, Ctrl/Cmd + S):

gui_dependency <-
  htmltools::htmlDependency(
    name = "reference-gui",
    version = "1.1.0",
    src =
      c("src/js", "../js") %>%
      keep(fs::dir_exists) %>%
      first() %>%
      fs::path_abs(),
    script = "reference_gui.js"
  )

comment_classes <- c("formatting", "parsimony", "best_practice")

assignment_types <- c("problem_set", "extra_credit", "final_exam")

item_types <- c("question", "policy")

# A titled card -- the single building block of every tab:

gui_card <-
  function(.title, .body, .foot = NULL) {
    div(
      class = "gui-card",
      div(class = "gui-card-head", .title),
      div(class = "gui-card-body", .body),
      .foot
    )
  }

# The left column of a tab: a search box, the record list, and its buttons:

record_list <-
  function(.prefix, .title, .extra = NULL) {
    gui_card(
      .title,
      tagList(
        .extra,
        textInput(
          str_c(.prefix, "_search"),
          NULL,
          placeholder = "Search",
          width = "100%"
        ),
        div(
          class = "gui-record-list",
          selectInput(
            str_c(.prefix, "_record"),
            NULL,
            choices = NULL,
            selectize = FALSE,
            size = 14,
            width = "100%"
          )
        ),
        div(
          class = "gui-list-actions",
          actionButton(
            str_c(.prefix, "_new"),
            "New",
            class = "gui-btn gui-btn-ghost"
          ),
          actionButton(
            str_c(.prefix, "_delete"),
            "Delete",
            class = "gui-btn gui-btn-danger"
          )
        )
      )
    )
  }

# The action bar that closes an editing card:

card_foot <-
  function(.prefix, .buttons) {
    div(
      class = "gui-card-foot",
      .buttons,
      div(
        id = str_c(.prefix, "_message"),
        class = "gui-message",
        textOutput(str_c(.prefix, "_status"), inline = TRUE)
      )
    )
  }

# The right column of a record tab: the fields, save, and a status line:

record_editor <-
  function(.prefix, .title, .fields, .save_label, .copy_label = NULL) {
    gui_card(
      .title,
      .fields,
      card_foot(
        .prefix,
        tagList(
          actionButton(
            str_c(.prefix, "_save"),
            .save_label,
            class = "gui-btn gui-btn-primary gui-save"
          ),
          if (is.null(.copy_label)) {
            NULL
          } else {
            actionButton(
              str_c(.prefix, "_copy"),
              .copy_label,
              class = "gui-btn gui-btn-ghost"
            )
          }
        )
      )
    )
  }

# A picker-only left column, for tabs that select a parent record:

picker_card <-
  function(.title, .input_id, .size = 14) {
    gui_card(
      .title,
      div(
        class = "gui-record-list",
        selectInput(
          .input_id,
          NULL,
          choices = NULL,
          selectize = FALSE,
          size = .size,
          width = "100%"
        )
      )
    )
  }

# A tab holding a left column beside a right column:

split_tab <-
  function(.title, .left, .right) {
    tabPanel(
      title = .title,
      div(
        class = "gui-pane",
        .left,
        .right
      )
    )
  }

# A row of side-by-side fields:

field_row <-
  function(...) {
    div(class = "gui-field-row", ...)
  }

# A table styled for the dark theme:

gui_table <-
  function(.data, .selection = "none", .page_length = 12, .editable = FALSE) {
    datatable(
      .data,
      rownames = FALSE,
      selection = .selection,
      editable = .editable,
      class = "compact stripe hover",
      options =
        list(
          dom = "ftp",
          pageLength = .page_length,
          scrollX = TRUE
        )
    )
  }
```

```{r}
#| label: server
#| context: server

# status messages ---------------------------------------------------------

fn_note <- reactiveVal("")
gl_note <- reactiveVal("")
ds_note <- reactiveVal("")
gc_note <- reactiveVal("")
rb_note <- reactiveVal("")
ri_note <- reactiveVal("")
rc_note <- reactiveVal("")
ls_note <- reactiveVal("")
md_note <- reactiveVal("")

output$fn_status <- renderText(fn_note())
output$gl_status <- renderText(gl_note())
output$ds_status <- renderText(ds_note())
output$gc_status <- renderText(gc_note())
output$rb_status <- renderText(rb_note())
output$ri_status <- renderText(ri_note())
output$rc_status <- renderText(rc_note())
output$ls_status <- renderText(ls_note())
output$md_status <- renderText(md_note())

# reactive reads ----------------------------------------------------------

refresh <- reactiveVal(0)

bump <-
  function() {
    refresh(isolate(refresh()) + 1)
    session$sendCustomMessage("reference_gui_clean", list())
  }

functions_data <-
  reactive({
    refresh()
    read_reference(con, "functions") %>%
      arrange(package, function_name)
  })

glossary_data <-
  reactive({
    refresh()
    read_reference(con, "glossary") %>%
      arrange(term)
  })

datasets_data <-
  reactive({
    refresh()
    read_reference(con, "datasets") %>%
      arrange(dataset_name)
  })

comments_data <-
  reactive({
    refresh()
    read_reference(con, "grading_comments") %>%
      arrange(comment_class, comment_subclass, short_name)
  })

assignments_data <-
  reactive({
    refresh()
    read_reference(con, "assignments") %>%
      arrange(assignment_type, assignment_name)
  })

all_items_data <-
  reactive({
    refresh()
    read_reference(con, "rubric_items") %>%
      left_join(assignments_data(), by = "assignment_id") %>%
      arrange(assignment_name, item_type, item_order)
  })

lessons_data <-
  reactive({
    refresh()
    read_reference(con, "lessons") %>%
      arrange(module_number, slug)
  })

modules_data <-
  reactive({
    refresh()
    read_reference(con, "modules") %>%
      arrange(module_number)
  })

lesson_choices <-
  reactive({
    lessons_data() %>%
      select(slug, lesson_id) %>%
      deframe()
  })

# header ------------------------------------------------------------------

output$status_bar <-
  renderUI({
    reference_counts(con) %>%
      imap(
        \(.n, .table) {
          span(
            class = "gui-stat",
            str_replace_all(.table, "_", " "),
            tags$strong(.n)
          )
        }
      )
  })

# functions ---------------------------------------------------------------

fn_id <- reactiveVal(NA_integer_)

observe({
  choices <-
    functions_data() %>%
    mutate(label = str_c(package, "::", function_name)) %>%
    filter(str_like(label, str_c("%", coalesce(input$fn_search, ""), "%"))) %>%
    select(label, function_id) %>%
    deframe()

  updateSelectInput(
    session,
    "fn_record",
    choices = choices,
    selected = fn_id()
  )
})

observe({
  updateSelectizeInput(
    session,
    "fn_lessons",
    choices = lesson_choices(),
    selected = isolate(input$fn_lessons),
    server = TRUE
  )
})

observeEvent(input$fn_record, {
  fn_id(as.integer(input$fn_record))

  record <-
    functions_data() %>%
    filter(function_id == as.integer(input$fn_record))

  updateTextInput(session, "fn_package", value = record$package)
  updateTextInput(session, "fn_name", value = record$function_name)
  updateTextAreaInput(session, "fn_definition", value = record$definition)

  updateSelectizeInput(
    session,
    "fn_lessons",
    choices = lesson_choices(),
    selected = usage_lessons(con, "function_usage", "function_id", fn_id()),
    server = TRUE
  )
})

observeEvent(input$fn_new, {
  fn_id(NA_integer_)
  updateTextInput(session, "fn_package", value = "")
  updateTextInput(session, "fn_name", value = "")
  updateTextAreaInput(session, "fn_definition", value = "")

  updateSelectizeInput(
    session,
    "fn_lessons",
    choices = lesson_choices(),
    selected = character(0),
    server = TRUE
  )

  fn_note("New function -- fill the fields and save.")
})

observeEvent(input$fn_save, {
  values <-
    tibble(
      package = input$fn_package,
      function_name = input$fn_name,
      definition = input$fn_definition
    )

  if (is.na(fn_id())) {
    append_reference(con, "functions", values)
    fn_id(last_reference_id(con))
  } else {
    update_reference(
      con,
      "functions",
      values %>% mutate(function_id = fn_id()),
      .by = "function_id"
    )
  }

  sync_usage(con, "function_usage", "function_id", fn_id(), input$fn_lessons)
  bump()
  fn_note(str_c("Saved ", input$fn_name, "()."))
})

observeEvent(input$fn_delete, {
  delete_with_usage(con, "functions", "function_usage", "function_id", fn_id())
  fn_id(NA_integer_)
  bump()
  fn_note("Deleted.")
})

observeEvent(input$fn_copy, {
  session$sendCustomMessage(
    "reference_gui_copy",
    list(
      text = input$fn_definition,
      flash = "fn_message"
    )
  )

  fn_note("Definition copied.")
})

# datasets ----------------------------------------------------------------

ds_id <- reactiveVal(NA_integer_)

observe({
  choices <-
    datasets_data() %>%
    filter(
      str_like(dataset_name, str_c("%", coalesce(input$ds_search, ""), "%"))
    ) %>%
    select(dataset_name, dataset_id) %>%
    deframe()

  updateSelectInput(
    session,
    "ds_record",
    choices = choices,
    selected = ds_id()
  )
})

observeEvent(input$ds_record, {
  ds_id(as.integer(input$ds_record))

  record <-
    datasets_data() %>%
    filter(dataset_id == as.integer(input$ds_record))

  updateTextInput(session, "ds_name", value = record$dataset_name)

  updateTextInput(
    session,
    "ds_display",
    value = coalesce(record$display_name, "")
  )

  updateTextInput(session, "ds_files", value = coalesce(record$files, ""))
  updateTextAreaInput(session, "ds_description", value = record$description)
})

observeEvent(input$ds_new, {
  ds_id(NA_integer_)
  updateTextInput(session, "ds_name", value = "")
  updateTextInput(session, "ds_display", value = "")
  updateTextInput(session, "ds_files", value = "")
  updateTextAreaInput(session, "ds_description", value = "")
  ds_note("New dataset -- fill the fields and save.")
})

observeEvent(input$ds_save, {
  values <-
    tibble(
      dataset_name = input$ds_name,
      display_name = na_if(input$ds_display, ""),
      files = na_if(input$ds_files, ""),
      description = input$ds_description
    )

  if (is.na(ds_id())) {
    append_reference(con, "datasets", values)
    ds_id(last_reference_id(con))
  } else {
    update_reference(
      con,
      "datasets",
      values %>% mutate(dataset_id = ds_id()),
      .by = "dataset_id"
    )
  }

  bump()
  ds_note(str_c("Saved ", input$ds_name, "."))
})

observeEvent(input$ds_delete, {
  delete_with_usage(con, "datasets", "dataset_usage", "dataset_id", ds_id())
  ds_id(NA_integer_)
  bump()
  ds_note("Deleted.")
})

observeEvent(input$ds_copy, {
  session$sendCustomMessage(
    "reference_gui_copy",
    list(
      text = input$ds_description,
      flash = "ds_message"
    )
  )

  ds_note("Description copied.")
})

# grading comments --------------------------------------------------------

gc_id <- reactiveVal(NA_integer_)

observe({
  choices <-
    comments_data() %>%
    filter(
      coalesce(input$gc_filter, "all") %in% c("all", comment_class),
      str_like(
        str_c(short_name, comment_text),
        str_c("%", coalesce(input$gc_search, ""), "%")
      )
    ) %>%
    select(short_name, comment_id) %>%
    deframe()

  updateSelectInput(
    session,
    "gc_record",
    choices = choices,
    selected = gc_id()
  )
})

observe({
  updateSelectizeInput(
    session,
    "gc_subclass",
    choices = sort(unique(comments_data()$comment_subclass)),
    selected = isolate(input$gc_subclass)
  )
})

observeEvent(input$gc_record, {
  gc_id(as.integer(input$gc_record))

  record <-
    comments_data() %>%
    filter(comment_id == as.integer(input$gc_record))

  updateTextInput(session, "gc_short_name", value = record$short_name)
  updateSelectInput(session, "gc_class", selected = record$comment_class)

  updateSelectizeInput(
    session,
    "gc_subclass",
    choices = sort(unique(comments_data()$comment_subclass)),
    selected = record$comment_subclass
  )

  updateTextAreaInput(session, "gc_text", value = record$comment_text)
})

observeEvent(input$gc_new, {
  gc_id(NA_integer_)
  updateTextInput(session, "gc_short_name", value = "")
  updateTextAreaInput(session, "gc_text", value = "")
  gc_note("New comment -- fill the fields and save.")
})

observeEvent(input$gc_save, {
  values <-
    tibble(
      short_name = input$gc_short_name,
      comment_class = input$gc_class,
      comment_subclass = input$gc_subclass,
      comment_text = input$gc_text
    )

  if (is.na(gc_id())) {
    append_reference(con, "grading_comments", values)
    gc_id(last_reference_id(con))
  } else {
    update_reference(
      con,
      "grading_comments",
      values %>% mutate(comment_id = gc_id()),
      .by = "comment_id"
    )
  }

  bump()
  gc_note(str_c("Saved ", input$gc_short_name, "."))
})

observeEvent(input$gc_delete, {
  delete_reference(con, "grading_comments", "comment_id", gc_id())
  gc_id(NA_integer_)
  bump()
  gc_note("Deleted.")
})

observeEvent(input$gc_copy, {
  session$sendCustomMessage(
    "reference_gui_copy",
    list(
      text = input$gc_text,
      flash = "gc_message"
    )
  )

  gc_note("Comment copied.")
})

# assignments -------------------------------------------------------------

rb_id <- reactiveVal(NA_integer_)

observe({
  choices <-
    assignments_data() %>%
    filter(
      str_like(assignment_name, str_c("%", coalesce(input$rb_search, ""), "%"))
    ) %>%
    select(assignment_name, assignment_id) %>%
    deframe()

  updateSelectInput(
    session,
    "rb_record",
    choices = choices,
    selected = rb_id()
  )
})

observeEvent(input$rb_record, {
  rb_id(as.integer(input$rb_record))

  record <-
    assignments_data() %>%
    filter(assignment_id == as.integer(input$rb_record))

  updateTextInput(session, "rb_name", value = record$assignment_name)
  updateSelectInput(session, "rb_type", selected = record$assignment_type)
  updateNumericInput(session, "rb_total", value = record$total_points)

  updateTextAreaInput(
    session,
    "rb_description",
    value = coalesce(record$description, "")
  )
})

observeEvent(input$rb_new, {
  rb_id(NA_integer_)
  updateTextInput(session, "rb_name", value = "")
  updateNumericInput(session, "rb_total", value = 10)
  updateTextAreaInput(session, "rb_description", value = "")
  rb_note("New assignment -- fill the fields and save.")
})

observeEvent(input$rb_save, {
  values <-
    tibble(
      assignment_name = input$rb_name,
      assignment_type = input$rb_type,
      total_points = input$rb_total,
      description = na_if(input$rb_description, "")
    )

  if (is.na(rb_id())) {
    append_reference(con, "assignments", values)
    rb_id(last_reference_id(con))
  } else {
    update_reference(
      con,
      "assignments",
      values %>% mutate(assignment_id = rb_id()),
      .by = "assignment_id"
    )
  }

  bump()
  rb_note(str_c("Saved ", input$rb_name, "."))
})

observeEvent(input$rb_delete, {
  delete_assignment(con, rb_id())
  rb_id(NA_integer_)
  bump()
  rb_note("Deleted assignment and its rubric.")
})

# rubric items ------------------------------------------------------------

observe({
  updateSelectInput(
    session,
    "ri_assignment",
    choices =
      assignments_data() %>%
      select(assignment_name, assignment_id) %>%
      deframe(),
    selected = isolate(input$ri_assignment)
  )
})

ri_items_data <-
  reactive({
    all_items_data() %>%
      filter(assignment_id == as.integer(input$ri_assignment)) %>%
      arrange(item_type, item_order) %>%
      select(
        item_id,
        item_type,
        item_order,
        item_label,
        criterion,
        max_points,
        deduction_pct,
        deduction_points,
        deduction_note
      )
  })

ri_selected <-
  reactive({
    ri_items_data() %>%
      slice(coalesce(input$ri_items_rows_selected, 0L)) %>%
      pull(item_id) %>%
      first(default = NA_integer_)
  })

output$ri_items <-
  renderDT({
    gui_table(
      ri_items_data(),
      .selection = "single",
      .page_length = 15,
      .editable = list(target = "cell", disable = list(columns = c(0, 1)))
    )
  })

observeEvent(input$ri_items_cell_edit, {
  edit <- input$ri_items_cell_edit
  column <- names(ri_items_data())[edit$col + 1]

  values <-
    tibble(
      item_id = ri_items_data()$item_id[edit$row],
      value =
        if (column %in% c("item_label", "criterion", "deduction_note")) {
          edit$value
        } else {
          as.numeric(edit$value)
        }
    ) %>%
    rename("{column}" := value)

  update_reference(con, "rubric_items", values, .by = "item_id")
  bump()
  ri_note(str_c("Updated ", column, "."))
})

observeEvent(input$ri_add, {
  req(input$ri_assignment)

  values <-
    tibble(
      assignment_id = as.integer(input$ri_assignment),
      item_type = input$ri_type,
      item_order = nrow(ri_items_data()) + 1L,
      item_label = input$ri_label,
      criterion = input$ri_criterion,
      max_points = input$ri_points,
      deduction_pct = input$ri_pct
    )

  append_reference(con, "rubric_items", values)
  bump()
  ri_note(str_c("Added ", input$ri_label, "."))
})

observeEvent(input$ri_delete, {
  req(!is.na(ri_selected()))

  delete_with_usage(
    con,
    "rubric_items",
    "rubric_item_comments",
    "item_id",
    ri_selected()
  )

  bump()
  ri_note("Deleted rubric item.")
})

# rubric comments ---------------------------------------------------------

observe({
  updateSelectInput(
    session,
    "rc_item",
    choices =
      all_items_data() %>%
      mutate(
        label =
          str_c(
            assignment_name, "  ",
            item_label, "  ",
            str_trunc(criterion, 40)
          )
      ) %>%
      select(label, item_id) %>%
      deframe(),
    selected = isolate(input$rc_item)
  )
})

observe({
  updateSelectizeInput(
    session,
    "rc_comment",
    choices =
      comments_data() %>%
      mutate(label = str_c(short_name, " -- ", str_trunc(comment_text, 70))) %>%
      select(label, comment_id) %>%
      deframe(),
    selected = isolate(input$rc_comment),
    server = TRUE
  )
})

rc_links_data <-
  reactive({
    refresh()
    req(input$rc_item)

    tbl(con, "rubric_item_comments") %>%
      filter(item_id == !!as.integer(input$rc_item)) %>%
      left_join(tbl(con, "grading_comments"), by = "comment_id") %>%
      select(link_id, short_name, comment_class, deduction, comment_text) %>%
      arrange(short_name) %>%
      collect()
  })

output$rc_links <-
  renderDT({
    gui_table(
      rc_links_data(),
      .selection = "single",
      .page_length = 10
    )
  })

observeEvent(input$rc_link, {
  req(input$rc_item, input$rc_comment)

  values <-
    tibble(
      item_id = as.integer(input$rc_item),
      comment_id = as.integer(input$rc_comment),
      deduction = input$rc_deduction
    )

  append_reference(con, "rubric_item_comments", values)
  bump()
  rc_note("Linked grading comment.")
})

observeEvent(input$rc_unlink, {
  req(input$rc_links_rows_selected)

  link <-
    rc_links_data() %>%
    slice(input$rc_links_rows_selected) %>%
    pull(link_id)

  delete_reference(con, "rubric_item_comments", "link_id", link)
  bump()
  rc_note("Unlinked grading comment.")
})
```
